Scene 02 · Skill set

The Chapters

Four areas I work in, and exactly what I do in each one.

CHAPTER I

Build

Websites and landing pages made to turn visitors into enquiries.

  • WordPress websitesFull business sites with service pages, blogs, careers and contact forms.
  • Landing pagesFocused single pages built for a Google or Meta ad campaign.
  • Google Business ProfileSet up and kept up to date so local customers can find and call.
  • On-page SEOClear page structure and content so search engines understand the site.
CHAPTER II

Grow

Paid and organic channels that bring in leads.

  • Google AdsCampaigns that put a business in front of people already searching.
  • Meta AdsFacebook and Instagram ads with creative made to stop the scroll.
  • Lead generationAds, pages and follow-up working together to bring in enquiries.
  • Social media managementPlanning, designing and posting content on a steady schedule.
  • Content writingCaptions, ad copy and website text in a clear, simple voice.
CHAPTER III

Capture

Photos and videos that show a business at its best.

  • PhotographyProduct, place and people shots for websites and posts.
  • VideographyShooting short-form video on location.
  • Video editingCutting reels with pacing, text and sound for social media.
  • Post designSocial media posts designed in Canva, like the Poster Wall below.
CHAPTER IV

Organise

Documents, records and daily operations kept accurate and easy to find.

  • CRMManaging client information and records in one place.
  • Microsoft OfficeAdvanced Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • AdministrationOffice support and day-to-day coordination.
  • DocumentationPreparing, organising and maintaining documents, including document control.
  • Accounting and bookkeepingWorking knowledge of accounts and record keeping.
